item.title: When The Internet Goes Silent, Distance Becomes Painfully Real
item.description: The AFCON tournament in Morocco is drawing to a close, and with the internet off in Uganda, the author is looking forward to returning home to warmth, familiarity, and the people they love. item.title: Internet returns to Uganda following election shutdown and Museveni win
item.description: The internet was restored in Uganda on Saturday evening after being shut down for almost 100 hours, with H.E Yoweri Kaguta Museveni declared the winner of the January 15th general elections. The post Internet returns to Uganda following election shutdown and Museveni win appeared first on MBU.

item.title: While You Were Away: Top 5 Story Picks From When The Internet Was Shutdown
item.description: Yoweri Kaguta Museveni was declared the winner of the 2026 presidential elections in Uganda, schools reopening was delayed for safety during the election process, Bobi Wine revealed an escape from a raid on his home, Joshua Baraka received a MOBO Awards nomination, and the US suspended immigrant visas for Uganda and 74 other countries. The post While You Were Away: Top 5 Story Picks From When The Internet Was Shutdown appeared first on MBU.

item.title: Calvin Bassey and Eva Apio fuel romance speculation at AFCON 2025
item.description: Eva Apio, a Ugandan-born British model, was seen at the AFCON 2025 third-place playoff between Nigeria and Egypt with Calvin Bassey, sparking rumors that the two are dating. The post Calvin Bassey and Eva Apio fuel romance speculation at AFCON 2025 appeared first on MBU.

item.title: A Pass reveals injuries after alleged election day assault
item.description: Singer A Pass was beaten near a polling station during the January 15 presidential and parliamentary elections in Uganda, and was attacked by three men, two of whom were in army uniform. The post A Pass reveals injuries after alleged election day assault appeared first on MBU.

item.title: Eva Apio sets record straight on Calvin Bassey romance rumors
item.description: Eva Apio has denied rumors that she is romantically involved with Fulham FC defender Calvin Bassey, stating that they have been friends since they were 16 years old. The post Eva Apio sets record straight on Calvin Bassey romance rumors appeared first on MBU.

item.title: Tuff B thanks supporters after losing to NUP’s Ali Kasirye
